$comment: Derived by reading the real React source in src/ (App.jsx route table, src/pages/*.jsx section markup, src/components/*.jsx), not from a crawl or a screenshot pass. Every template's section list is the actual top-to-bottom JSX order in that page component. Where an earlier spec document (CLONE_SPEC.md) disagreed with the source, the source won.

meta.source: Local React clone of https://www.natural.com/ at /Users/riyaghosh/V2 cloned/Natural
meta.generatedBy: ia-builder skill, read directly from src/App.jsx + src/pages/*.jsx

categories.CHROME: Site-wide furniture mounted outside the router in App.jsx, present on every route.
categories.HERO: The page-opening block that carries the route's h1.
categories.NARRATIVE: Marketing explanation blocks: what the product does, how it works, who it is for.
categories.PROOF: Third-party credibility: investors, customer logos, testimonials.
categories.CONTENT: The substantive body of a content route (post lists, role lists, pricing tables, forms).
categories.CONVERSION: Blocks whose job is to move the visitor to sign up or make contact.

chrome.navbar.description: Fixed top navigation: wordmark, a Products mega-menu, flat links, and sign-up/contact actions. Mounted once outside <Routes> so it never remounts on navigation.

chrome.footer.description: Site footer: grouped link columns, wordmark, and legal line. Mounted once outside <Routes>, after <main>.

hero.scroll-dashboard.description: Homepage-only scroll-scrubbed hero. A sticky viewport-height stage holds a news pill, the two-tone h1 and the CTA pair, while a 48px box expands into the full dashboard screenshot as --progress runs 0 to 1. All sizing is viewport-height-relative, not fixed-pixel.

hero.product-detail.description: Product-route hero: h1, a short body paragraph with its own entrance delay, a sign-up CTA pair, and a wide product screenshot below.

hero.statement.description: Tall centred statement hero carrying only an oversized h1 and no imagery, used to open the company-story routes.

hero.page-title.description: Compact left-aligned title block that opens a content index route with an h1 and nothing else.

narrative.benefits-speed.description: Homepage speed/latency benefit block, the first explanatory section after the hero.

narrative.flows.description: Homepage tabbed payment-flow explainer with an animated graphic per tab.

narrative.control.description: Homepage block on agent permissions, limits and control, with a tabbed/stepped visual.

narrative.developers.description: Homepage developer-experience block showing API/code affordances.

narrative.benefits-scale.description: Homepage scale/volume benefit block, paired visually with the speed block earlier on the page.

narrative.feature-card-grid.description: Eyebrow, h2 and a three-up card grid of feature cards, each with a title, one line of body copy and a graphic. The per-route copy comes from productContent.js.

narrative.company-story.description: Long-form prose block on the company's origin and purpose, set as a single wide paragraph under an h2.

narrative.values.description: Numbered or headed list of company values/principles, one short paragraph each.

narrative.team.description: Team/leadership block introducing the people behind the company.

narrative.benefits-perks.description: Employee benefits and perks block on the careers route, distinct from the homepage product-benefit sections.

proof.investors.description: Filterable wall of investor and angel cards, each a quote with an attributed name. Fund cards and angel cards use different widths at desktop and collapse to one width on mobile.

content.blog-teaser.description: Homepage three-up teaser of recent posts, linking into the blog index. Not the blog index's own listing.

content.blog-index.description: Blog index listing with a role=tablist filter row above it, rendering every post as an image, title and date.

content.blog-newsletter.description: Closing block on the blog index inviting a newsletter subscription. Stands in for the final CTA that every other route carries.

content.open-roles.description: Anchored (#open-roles) list of open positions on a tinted background, headed by the role count rendered as a second h2.

content.pricing-table.description: Grouped pricing table with a sticky desktop-only category nav on the left, collapsing to a single stacked column on mobile.

content.contact-form.description: Full-height centred contact form. This route's only block: it carries its own h1 and has no separate hero.

conversion.final-cta.description: Shared closing call-to-action band with a heading and a sign-up action, rendered immediately before the footer.
conversion.final-cta.scope: 15 of the 16 routes — every route except /blog, which closes with its newsletter block instead. On /careers it is wrapped in a .careers-cta div that raises its vertical padding from 80px to 240px.
